what_it_does: This paper describes a high-speed communication link designed for chiplets—individual specialized processor tiles that work together—and short-distance memory connections. The link sends data using PAM3 (Pulse Amplitude Modulation with 3 levels), a technique that encodes more information in each pulse than simpler on-off signaling. The key challenge is handling noise from the power supply, voltage reference drift between sender and receiver, and crosstalk (interference from neighboring signals). The design tolerates these problems while achieving energy efficiency of 0.275 picojoules per bit at 42 gigabits per second per pin.
